name: Market Identification 95
definition: Details on a trading venue as per ISO 10383.

Segment.name: Segment
Segment.definition: Segment MIC of the venue where it exists, otherwise the Operating MIC.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Define the type of Market Identification Code that is being supplied.

Category.name: Category
Category.definition: Provides the category of market the venue operates in.

InstitutionName.name: Institution Name
InstitutionName.definition: The name or description of the institution, market, or infrastructure.

Acronym.name: Acronym
Acronym.definition: Known acronym of the institution, market, or infrastructure.

City.name: City
City.definition: City where the institution, market, or infrastructure operates.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Two character country code and country name as per ISO 3166.

AuthorityName.name: Authority Name
AuthorityName.definition: The name of the national competent authority associated with the MIC.

WebSite.name: Web Site
WebSite.definition: Website URI of the institution, market, or infrastructure.

Note.name: Note
Note.definition: Details additional information about the market operator.

Modification.name: Modification
Modification.definition: Additional information to help users identify the exchange or understand a modification.

CreationDate.name: Creation Date
CreationDate.definition: First date of the MIC issuance.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Details the validity of the specific record.

StatusDate.name: Status Date
StatusDate.definition: Date when the market identification code was last modified.

LastUpdatedDate.name: Last Updated Date
LastUpdatedDate.definition: Date when this record was last modified.
